title: CalendarPackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly calendar (INV-REQ-83, INV-REQ-87, INV-REQ-88, INV-REQ-1350). Names are those of the CalendarPack of calendar-and-periods 1.0.0. The envelope schema rule-pack-staged-payload.schema.json keeps contents opaque and is unchanged. There is no transition property: a frequency change is cut only at the change date (INV-AC-154), and a contents document that declares one is refused because additionalProperties is false. A later schema version adds one only by a new ruling and task. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express are tested by the decoder task, not here: the windows of one frequency do not overlap; a window ends on or after its start; every window's returnForm and finalReturnForm each has a due rule in dueRules; at least one day of the week is not in weekend. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4).

windows.description: Filing windows by filing-frequency code; each value lists the windows of that frequency.

additionalProperties.description: The windows of one filing frequency.

end.description: Last day of the window; on or after start.

returnForm.description: The return form filed for the window.

finalReturnForm.description: The return form of the final return.

dueRules.description: Due rules keyed by return form.

monthsAfterEnd.description: Whole months after the window end.

endOfMonth.description: Whether the due date moves to the end of that month.

weekend.description: The days of the week that are not working days.

pinnedRule.description: The non-business-day rule the pack pins (INV-REQ-87); absent means the pack pins nothing.
